name: Frauenkirche (Munich): doors
_about: The Frauenkirche's doors: the main portal in the porch between the towers (shut, a wicket in it) and the inner portal behind it, the four side portals in their ogee frames, the towers' doors into the church and the south tower's stair turret.

doors._about: the main portal, in the porch
the inner portal into the church
the four side portals, in the first and sixth bays of either side
the towers' doors, from the church
